items.title: Hilb^d of an affine scheme is representable
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Prove Hilbfunctor^d_{X/S} is representable for affine X -> S: reduce to X = Spec(R[x_i; i in I]) via a closed immersion and lemma-hilb-d-of-closed; verify the glue-functors conditions: (1) the sheaf property (lemma-hilb-d-sheaf); for each d-element subset W of A define the subfunctor F_W of quotients where the O_T-linear map from the free module on W onto (Z->T)_*O_Z is surjective; openness (2)(b) by algebra-lemma-cokernel-flat; covering (2)(c) by choosing a basis of the fibre via Nakayama on an open neighbourhood; representability (2)(a) by the explicit universal algebra R_univ = R[c_{kl}^m, b^l, b_i^l]/a_univ with B_univ free of rank d, multiplication table e_k e_l = sum c_{kl}^m e_m, and the ideal a_univ generated by the commutativity, associativity, unit, and normalization (f_l |-> e_l) conditions.
